name: close-assistant-from-header
expression: (()=>{const b=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Collapse live assistant"]');if(!b)throw Error('Open assistant missing');b.click();return true;})()

name: assert-closed-no-orphan
expression: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const check=()=>{if(!document.querySelector('.live-assistant.is-open')&&!document.querySelector('.rail-assistant-toggle')){observer.disconnect();clearTimeout(timer);resolve({orphanButtons:0,launcher:!!document.querySelector('.live-assistant-launcher'),separators:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=separator]')].map(n=>n.getAttribute('aria-label'))})}};const observer=new MutationObserver(check);observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true});const timer=setTimeout(()=>{observer.disconnect();reject(Error('Closed Drawings has orphan rail control'))},6000);check();})
